notes.title: UPDATE V1.0
notes.content:
[b]Bug fix[/b]
- Application «Furniture»: ui flashing with compatibilities removed.
- Application “delivery” which disappears when you leave the email when you click on the “back” button.
- TV shelves and setup corrected.
- Decorations that when removed are not recovered
- Reorder of products to be released in the correct order for certain.
- Save graphics settings and keys

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Added numeric keypad to enter numbers on TPE when collecting from a customer
-Simplified multiplayer to create and join a game

[b]Coming soon:[/b]
- Translation of the game into French
- Enhanced multiplayer
- Customers in the store also improved
